name: culvert-openapi-gen
description: Isolated OpenAPI type-generator workspace (FE-1A). Separate from the app toolchain because openapi-typescript declares a required peer of typescript ^5.x while the app pins TypeScript 6.0.3 (ADR-FE-001); the generator only uses TypeScript to print the emitted file — the app's TS 6.0.3 type-checks the output.
